free_tier.stated: no free plan: Standard is USD 20 a month, one flat price for up to 50 seats, with USD 20 of usage included every month and pooled across the team
free_tier.notes: usage is metered in dollars across model inference, the Context Engine and Cosmos compute; included usage does not roll over; no trial length or allowance is published

interface_detail: Auggie CLI headless mode: `auggie --print "instruction"` runs one instruction without the UI and exits; `--mode stream` streams text and tool activity, `--mode json` prints structured output, stdin is piped in as context, and `--show-cost` adds the cost and credit usage of the run. Authentication for unattended runs is the session JSON from `auggie token print`, passed in the AUGMENT_SESSION_AUTH variable or with `--augment-session-json`, and `auggie auth login --headless` logs in on a machine with no browser. The docs flag non-interactive mode as possibly disabled when an enterprise agreement does not include it; whether print mode runs on Standard was not run (unverified: behind a sign-up)
tooling: Auggie CLI, installed from npm as @augmentcode/auggie on Node 20 or later (macOS, Windows WSL, Linux); the 1.x line is the npm prerelease tag and 0.x the stable v0-release tag. Cosmos is the vendor's hosted agent platform, included on the plan
chaining: the USD 20 balance buys at most USD 14.29 of model inference at provider list price once the 40% fee is added (USD 20 / 1.40 = USD 14.29), so it is a small first-party agent allowance rather than a bulk token source; models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Moonshot, DeepSeek and Zhipu draw from the one balance

limits.value: USD 20 of usage a month, pooled across up to 50 seats; model inference at the provider's list price plus a flat 40% fee, Cosmos compute at USD 0.19 per hour in 5-minute increments with no fee; unused usage does not roll over; past the balance, billing continues pay-as-you-go at the same rates

limits_note: the pricing page lists Cosmos on Standard with standard size compute, daemon mode and 50 concurrent sessions; top-ups bought outside the plan are valid 12 months. Per-million-token list rates before the 40% fee include Claude Sonnet 5.5 at USD 2.00 input and USD 10.00 output, Claude Haiku 5.5 at USD 0.10 and USD 0.50, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at USD 0.30 and USD 1.20, and Kimi K3 at USD 3.00 and USD 15.00
binding_note: the dollar balance is spent on inference at list price plus 40% before any seat or concurrency limit applies, and overage bills pay-as-you-go

identity_cost.detail: sign-in is with Google, Microsoft or an email address and a single-use code, and the terms are accepted on the first sign-in (documented for the IDE sign-in portal); a paid plan needs a valid credit card under Account > Billing. The Cosmos sign-up form itself was not seen: cosmos.augmentcode.com redirects through auth.augmentcode.com to login.augmentcode.com, which answered HTTP 400 to a request with no browser session. Phone number and ID document: unverified: no page read asks for either

reliability_note: Harness announced on 2026-10-08 that it acquired select Augment Code assets, among them Cosmos, the Auggie CLI and the Code Context Engine, and the Cosmos product is being renamed Harness Cosmos Software Factory Agent; the pricing page still sells Standard and sign-in still runs on augmentcode.com hosts on 2026-11-02, and the Auggie 1.x CLI is a prerelease
confidence_note: prices, the 40% fee, the compute rate, the model list and the headless flags are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02. The trial terms, the sign-up form and whether print mode runs on this plan were not seen. The model table is a snapshot: the vendor says rates change and models vary by workspace.

notes: Augment Code Standard: USD 20 a month for up to 50 seats with USD 20 of usage, the lower-priced of the two self-serve plans, both of which list CLI access. Models listed on 2026-11-02 include Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra, GPT-6 Astra and Luna, Gemini 4 Argon, 3.8 Flash and 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and two Prism routing options; some are offered only in eligible workspaces. Trial: no self-serve trial length or allowance is published on the pricing page; the Harness page for the same product says to try it free with no credit card, the docs say a new Cosmos account may be eligible for complimentary credits, and the professional terms give a trial order a default term of 3 months. The Business plan has its own record.
